FanGraphs run expectancy matrix

Source: R/reviewed_base_out.R
run_expectancy_fangraphs.Rd

Expected runs from a base-out state to the end of the inning, as published in the FanGraphs RE24 library entry for a run environment of 4.15 runs per game. The format matches the expectancy argument of calculate_run_impact().

Usage

run_expectancy_fangraphs

Format

A data frame with 24 rows and 3 columns:

outs

Integer outs, 0 to 2.

bases

Integer base mask: 1 for first, 2 for second, 4 for third.

expected_runs

Numeric expected runs to the end of the inning.

Source

Weinberg, Neil. 2014. "RE24." FanGraphs, July 30. https://library.fangraphs.com/misc/re24/. Values transcribed November 8, 2026.

Details

One published matrix is applied to every game. Real run environments differ by season and park, so RE24 totals from this table are approximate. Callers can supply a season-specific matrix in the same format.

Examples

xtabs(expected_runs ~ bases + outs, run_expectancy_fangraphs)
#>      outs
#> bases     0     1     2
#>     0 0.461 0.243 0.095
#>     1 0.831 0.489 0.214
#>     2 1.068 0.644 0.305
#>     3 1.373 0.908 0.343
#>     4 1.426 0.865 0.413
#>     5 1.798 1.140 0.471
#>     6 1.920 1.352 0.570
#>     7 2.282 1.520 0.736
